scripts: Bluestar wants to talk to you.

I've been watching you, and I just...

But we'll have to keep this a secret, you know.

Hi! You already know me, right?

paw went off to the hunting grounds...

Would you like me to tell you a story?
I'll tell you about two of our warriors.
Darkkit was always fierce and sly, but Stonekit, his brother, was not.
Darkpaw often told me that the other apprentices were stealing prey...
...So that the apprentices would be kept in the camp.
Then he could go outside and practice his battle skills.
Soon his skills were better than any other apprentice's skills.
Bluepaw was my apprentice, many moons ago.
She was wise for an apprentice, and she was good at hunting.
I trained her as well as I could.
During the Great Battle, which happened five moons ago...
Bluepaw and I fought together, driving out the loners.
That night, she received her warrior name, Bluemist.
I'll tell you about the twolegplace.
When I was your age, I lived with my mother and brother...
...In a dark, abandoned area of the twolegplace.
It was damp and cold there.
One day, a twoleg caught me while I was hunting.
And he brought me back to his own den.
But later- No, that's a different story.
I'll tell you about the Great Battle.
During one of my training sessions with Bluepaw...
We heard a loud noise from the camp entrance.
It was a group of rogues!
They attacked our camp fiercely, fighting together.
We lost many brave warriors that day.
But the other clans arrived to save us, and we drove out the rogues.
Your mother, Oatbird, was my best friend, moons ago.
Although she was younger than I, we were very good friends.
She was wise for her age, and good at planning things.
You are a lot like her, you know.
When I was living with the twoleg...
I was hungry and cold, because the twoleg often forgot to feed me.
One day, I crept away from his den...
And met a young, friendly white tom. His name was Rainpaw.
When he heard about my lonely life in the twoleg den...
He brought me back to his clan.
The leader agreed to let me stay...
And I was apprenticed, taking the name Brightpaw.
During the Great Battle, our deputy, Honeypelt...
...was killed trying to save a tiny kit.
After the battle, our leader had to choose a new deputy.
Both Bluemist and Darkthorn wanted to become deputy.
Bluemist wanted to be deputy so that she could protect her clan.
Darkthorn wanted to be deputy so that he could drive out all rogues.
That night, the leader chose a deputy.
I'll tell you more about your mother, Oatbird.
When I was your age, a young warrior...
My best friend, Oatbird, would often leave the camp...
And sit by the ShadowClan border.
One day, I went to ask her to come on patrol...
But she was playing with a ShadowClan cat!
The ShadowClan cat was a young tom...
He apologized politely to me for crossing the border.
He said he was only trying to patrol, but got lost.
I told him the way back to his camp...
Then Oatbird and I went home together.
Honeypelt, our fomer deputy, was Rushpool's brother.
Rushpool was our wise medicine cat.
The two cats were kind and friendly, and did much for their clan.
Many cats respected them for their wisdom.
When I first came to this clan, Honeypelt mentored me.
The only one who didn't like the two cats was Darkthorn.
Both Honeypelt and Rushpool were killed in the Great Battle.
